sections.title: Bombers' Notebook
sections.note: The notebook's 20 people, in its order. Tick a person when their Happiness Seal is earned. Promise stickers grey out after the Song of Time; the items you were given stay.

items.name: Bombers
items.howTo: In the first cycle, as a Deku, find all five Bombers around Clock Town in their hide-and-seek to learn the secret code (it gets you into the Astral Observatory). Later, as human Link, give the code at the hideout, or play hide-and-seek again, and Jim gives you the notebook.
items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D the Happy Mask Salesman gives you the notebook instead, and it tracks more than 50 entries.

items.name: Anju
items.area: Stock Pot Inn, East Clock Town
items.howTo: Day 1, 1:50–4 p.m.: say you have a reservation for the Room Key. Day 1 afternoon: talk to her in Kafei's Mask and agree to meet at 11:30 p.m. in the inn kitchen, where she gives you the Letter to Kafei to post. Day 2 afternoon or evening: give her the Pendant of Memories. Final Day, just before dawn: wait in the staff room for her reunion with Kafei.
items.reward: Room Key, Letter to Kafei, Couple's Mask
items.notes: Only the Couple's Mask outlasts the cycle. The whole chain, from Kafei's Mask to the reunion, has to be done in one cycle.

items.name: Kafei
items.area: Curiosity Shop back room, Laundry Pool
items.howTo: Post Anju's letter by Day 2 morning. On Day 2 around 3 p.m., slip into the back room behind the Laundry Pool while Kafei is out at the door collecting it; he gives you the Pendant of Memories. Final Day, from 6 p.m.: meet him by Sakon's Hideout in Ikana Canyon and help him take back the Sun's Mask, then wait at the inn for the reunion.
items.reward: Pendant of Memories, Couple's Mask (with Anju)

items.name: Man from Curiosity Shop
items.howTo: Final Day: once Kafei has given you the Pendant, find the shop owner in Kafei's back room; he gives you the Keaton Mask and the Special Delivery to Mama. Night of the Final Day, from 10 p.m.: buy the All-Night Mask in his shop for 500 Rupees, which he only has if you saved the Old Lady from the Bomb Shop on Night 1.
items.reward: Keaton Mask, Special Delivery to Mama, All-Night Mask

items.name: Old Lady from Bomb Shop
items.howTo: Night 1, midnight: Sakon grabs her bag in North Clock Town. Hit or shoot him before he escapes.
items.notes: Once she's saved, the Bomb Shop stocks the Big Bomb Bag (90 Rupees); if Sakon gets away, the Curiosity Shop sells it on the Final Night instead.

items.name: Romani
items.howTo: Day 1, 6 a.m.–6 p.m.: beat her balloon-shooting game to learn Epona's Song, and agree to help. Night 1, 2:30 a.m. until dawn: keep the ghosts ("them") away from the barn with your bow.
items.after: Powder Keg, to blow up the boulder on Milk Road

items.name: Cremia
items.howTo: After defending the barn on Night 1, talk to her in the barn on Day 2 and agree to come along. At 6 p.m. on Day 2, ride with her cart and shoot the masked Gorman Brothers who chase it through Gorman Track until you reach town.
items.notes: Wearing the Circus Leader's Mask makes the brothers back off.

items.name: Mr. Dotour
items.howTo: Day 1 or Day 2, 10 a.m.–8 p.m. (10 a.m.–6 p.m. on the Final Day): wear the Couple's Mask into the meeting room to end the argument, then talk to the Mayor.

items.name: Madame Aroma
items.area: Mayor's Residence; Milk Bar on the Final Day
items.howTo: Day 1 or Day 2, 10 a.m.–8 p.m.: agree to look for her son in the Mayor's Residence. Final Day: bring her the Special Delivery to Mama in the Milk Bar.
items.reward: Kafei's Mask, Bottle of Chateau Romani
items.notes: The Special Delivery to Mama goes either to her (the Bottle) or to the Postman (his hat), so this takes two cycles to do both.

items.name: Toto
items.howTo: Night 1 or Night 2, 10 p.m.–5 a.m.: wear Romani's Mask into the Milk Bar, talk to Toto and play his sound check as human Link, then as a Deku, a Goron and a Zora.
items.after: Romani's Mask, Goron and Zora Masks

items.name: Gorman
items.area: Stock Pot Inn; Milk Bar at night
items.howTo: Night 1 or Night 2, 10 p.m.–5 a.m.: finish Toto's sound check in the Milk Bar. The Ballad of the Wind Fish moves Gorman to tears.
items.notes: Majora's Mask 3D calls it the Troupe Leader's Mask and adds a Mystery Milk errand for him that gives a seventh Bottle.

items.name: Postman
items.howTo: Day 1 from 3 p.m. or Day 2 from 5 p.m. (until midnight): stop his timer at exactly 10 seconds in the Post Office. Final Day: give him the Special Delivery to Mama, then meet him by the Milk Bar as he leaves town.
items.notes: Wear the Bunny Hood for the counting game; the timer stays on screen.

items.name: Rosa Sisters
items.howTo: Night 1 or Night 2, 6 p.m.–6 a.m.: wear Kamaro's Mask and dance for them in West Clock Town.
Any night, midnight–6 a.m.: give the hand in the inn's toilet a Title Deed or a letter.

items.name: Anju's Grandmother
items.area: Stock Pot Inn, East Clock Town
items.howTo: Day 1 or Day 2, daytime: wear the All-Night Mask and listen to both her stories. For the Carnival of Time, answer that it's held on the eve of the carnival; for the Four Giants, answer "I dunno".

items.name: Kamaro
items.howTo: Any night, midnight–6 a.m.: play the Song of Healing for the dancing ghost on the rock in north Termina Field.

items.name: Grog
items.howTo: Any day, 6 a.m.–8 p.m.: wear the Bremen Mask and march until all ten chicks follow you.
items.after: Bremen Mask and the Powder Keg

items.name: Gorman Brothers
items.howTo: Any day, 6 a.m.–6 p.m.: ride Epona into Gorman Track, pay 10 Rupees and beat them in the race.

items.name: Shiro
items.howTo: Use the Lens of Truth in the ring of stones on the Road to Ikana to see him, and give him a Red or Blue Potion.
items.notes: In Majora's Mask 3D he stands in the Pirates' Fortress instead.

items.name: Guru-Guru
items.howTo: Night 1 or Night 2, 6 p.m.–6 a.m.: talk to him at the Laundry Pool in human form and hear his confession.
